_comment: Per-role model mixture for the parallel `--ollama` forge path. Copy to ollama_roles.json (gitignored) and edit, or just use `--ollama` for the built-in defaults in btsgen/ollama_mix.py. Models must be live in the catalog: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OLLAMA_API_KEY' https://ollama.com/v1/models
_max_tokens_cap_comment: Clamp every per-stage max_tokens request (the blueprint asks for 48000, sized for Claude; too high for most open models). Effective = min(requested, cap).

roles._brainstorm_comment: Divergent ideation (cloud/cluster + relic-intent). Small + permissive + warm. response_format=json_object pins output to valid JSON grammar. NOTE: map/compose moved to the 'structure' role — a small hot model emits unparseable JSON for that complex schema ~half the time even in JSON mode. To use a LOCAL uncensored model here instead, add e.g. "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1", "api_key": "ollama" to this role.
roles._structure_comment: Convergent + schema-strict: map/compose (_MapComposeContract) AND the dossier->card-briefs blueprint (_BlueprintContract). Strong, schema-faithful model, pinned to JSON.
roles._cards_comment: Codes the ~23 cards + the relic in strict closed-vocab JSON. Strong coder, low temperature, pinned to JSON.

_fallback_comment: Metered escape hatch for when the flat Ollama plan hits its GPU-time quota: the SAME harness re-issues the failed call per-token via OpenRouter (same model families). Inert until OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set; quota errors (429/402) divert all calls here for cooldown_s. Omit the key to inherit this default; set "fallback": null to disable.
